Name: Authorizing electronic registration of dwellings with the department of housing preservation and development and electronic payment of the fee associated with such registration.
Title: A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to authorizing electronic registration of dwellings with the department of housing preservation and development and electronic payment of the fee associated with such registration

History.Description: This Introduction was Hearing Held by Committee
This Introduction was Laid Over by Committee
This Introduction was Introduced by Council
This Introduction was Referred to Comm by Council to the Committee on Housing and Buildings

Summary: This bill would give property owners that need to register their property with the Department of Housing Preservation and Development (HPD) the option of doing so through an electronic registration system. Electronic signatures obtained via this method would be deemed sufficient for registration purposes. HPD would be required to maintain the electronic registration system on its website, and to accept electronic payments of the filing fee through such system.
Text:
A Local Law to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to authorizing electronic registration of dwellings with the department of housing preservation and development and electronic payment of the fee associated with such registration

Be it enacted by the Council as follows:

Section 1. Subdivision c of section 27-2097 of the administrative code of the city of New York, as amended by local law number 76 for the year 1993, is amended to read as follows:
c. An owner who is required to register shall file a new registration statement annually. Such registration statement, including any amendments thereto, may be filed using an electronic signature. The department shall maintain an electronic registration system on its website for purposes of compliance with this subdivision.
§ 2. Subdivisions b and c of section 27-2098 of the administrative code of the city of New York, as amended by local law number 76 for the year 1993, are amended to read as follows:
b. The registration statement shall be signed by the owner or, if the owner is a corporation, by any officer. In the appropriate case, either the managing agent or the designee described in paragraph five of subdivision a of this section shall sign the statement to indicate consent to the designation except that such consent is not required if an owner or officer of a corporation is registered as the managing agent. An owner, managing agent, or designee may sign such registration statement with an electronic signature using the electronic registration system required by subdivision c of section 27-2097.
c. The registration statement shall be filed on forms to be prescribed by the department and shall be accompanied by a filing fee of thirteen dollars. Such fee may be paid using the same electronic registration system required by subdivision c of section 27-2097. In the case of an owner previously registered with the department, no new filing fee shall be required for the filing of a supplemental registration.
§ 3. This local law takes effect 22 months after it becomes law.
